summary: Assess triggers, measure basis risk and strengthen product oversight with hands-on index data and payout reviews. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Agricultural index insurance training helps product teams assess whether triggers and payouts reflect farmers’ risks. It is for insurance specialists, programme managers and agricultural finance professionals who review product design and performance. Participants practise checking rainfall data and trigger structures, measuring basis risk, reviewing payout and portfolio records, and using complaints and farmer-value evidence to identify weaknesses and plan oversight actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, distribute, monitor or oversee index-based agricultural insurance and need to evaluate how product triggers perform for insured farmers.
modules: QGIS Spatial Review and Grievance Controls
prerequisites: Working knowledge of agricultural insurance, index products or agricultural programme delivery is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheet tables; no coding is required.
